## Function HTTP Handlers

The handlers of every route, with the JSON reading rules and the error body.

Behaviour: Declares in api/handlers.go: `type Handlers struct { Control control.Control }` and methods with the signature `func (h Handlers) X(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request)`: Projects, CreateProject, Status, Events, Messages, Pending, Answer, Interrupt, Usage, Restart, Plan, Continue, StopCheck, GithubToken; plus `func WriteJSON(w http.ResponseWriter, status int, v any)` (Content-Type application/json, then the status, then json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(v) — every body ends with "\n") and `func WriteError(w http.ResponseWriter, err error)` (status, code := control.Code(err); body {"error":{"code":<code>,"message":<err.Error()>}}; a 500 writes message "internal" instead of the error text). The project is r.PathValue("project"). Reading a body (CreateProject, Messages, Answer, Restart, Plan, GithubToken): Content-Type parsed with mime.ParseMediaType must be application/json else 415 {"error":{"code":"unsupported_media_type","message":"Content-Type must be application/json"}}; the body through http.MaxBytesReader(w, r.Body, 1<<20), a json.Decoder with DisallowUnknownFields into the request struct and a second Decode returning io.EOF, else 400 {"error":{"code":"bad_json","message":"bad json"}}. Projects: GET → 200 {"projects":[…]} (empty as []). CreateProject: {"name","language","repo_url"} → Control.CreateProject → 201 the view. Status → 200 the Status. Events: query since (int64, default 0) and max (int, default 0); a non-integer → 400 bad_input with message "since must be an integer" / "max must be an integer"; → 200 the Events. Messages: {"text"} → Control.Order → 200 the OrderResult. Pending → 200 {"question":<Question or null>}. Answer: {"option"} → 200 {"ok":true}. Interrupt → 200 {"ok":true}. Usage → 200 the Usage. Restart: {"force"} (an empty body allowed: force false — the body is read only when Content-Length is not 0) → 200 {"ok":true}. Plan: a queue.Plan → 200 the QueueView. Continue → 200 {"ok":true}. StopCheck → 200 {"stop":<Stop or null>}. GithubToken: {"token"} → 200 the TokenResult (the token never echoed). Every Control error → WriteError.

## Function Phase Loop

The state of one project's phase loop and the transitions the PM and the session drive.

Behaviour: Declares in supervisor/loop.go, exactly: `type Action struct { Kind string; Phase string; SessionID string; Resume bool; BudgetUSD float64; Line string; Milestone control.Milestone }`; `type Loop struct { Project string `json:"project"`; Queue queue.Queue `json:"queue"`; State string `json:"state"`; Phase string `json:"phase"`; SessionID string `json:"session_id"`; PhaseStartedAt time.Time `json:"phase_started_at"`; Resumes []time.Time `json:"resumes"`; Stop *control.Stop `json:"stop,omitempty"`; PausedUntil time.Time `json:"paused_until"`; StretchUSD float64 `json:"stretch_usd"`; SessionUSD float64 `json:"session_usd"`; LastEventAt time.Time `json:"last_event_at"`; Nudged bool `json:"nudged"`; Alerted bool `json:"alerted"` }`; `type Config struct { MaxResumesPerHour int; StallMinutes int; StretchUSD float64; UsageAlertPercent int }`; `var ErrPhaseMismatch = errors.New("phase mismatch")`; `func New(project string, q queue.Queue) *Loop` (State "idle"); `func (l *Loop) Begin(now time.Time) ([]Action, error)`; `func (l *Loop) StartChecked(s gitrules.Start, newID func() string, now time.Time) []Action`; `func (l *Loop) PhaseDone(phase, next string) ([]Action, error)`; `func (l *Loop) EndChecked(e gitrules.End, now time.Time) []Action`; `func (l *Loop) WaitOperator(kind, reason, issueURL string, now time.Time) []Action`; `func (l *Loop) Continue(now time.Time) ([]Action, error)`; `func (l *Loop) Restart(now time.Time) ([]Action, error)`. State is one of "idle", "starting", "running", "paused", "waiting". A post action is Action{Kind: "post", Milestone: {kind, headline, numbers}}. An action carries only the fields its literal names here, every other field zero: start_check and end_check {Kind, Phase}; spawn {Kind, Phase, SessionID, Resume, BudgetUSD}; first_line and write {Kind, Line}; kill {Kind}; post {Kind, Milestone}. Begin (meant for State "idle" or "waiting"): Queue.Start() must succeed — its error is returned as is and nothing changes (a starting, running or paused loop holds a running queue, so a Begin there fails on the queue's state); then Phase = that id, State "starting", Stop nil, Nudged false, Alerted false, SessionUSD 0, actions [{Kind "start_check", Phase}]. StartChecked (State "starting"; any other state → nil): Mode "fresh" → SessionID = newID(), Resumes nil, PhaseStartedAt = now, LastEventAt = now, State "running", actions [{Kind "spawn", Phase, SessionID, Resume false, BudgetUSD = the current phase''s Caps.ClaudeUSD}, {Kind "first_line", Line "/morph-orchestrator " + Phase}, {post start "<phase> started" numbers "session <id> · cap $<ClaudeUSD 'f' -1> · <Hours 'f' -1> h"}] (a Reason "pulled to …" appends " · " + Reason to the numbers); Mode "resume" → SessionID kept when non-empty else newID(), State "running", PhaseStartedAt = now, LastEventAt = now, actions [{spawn Resume true …}, {post start "<phase> resumed" numbers "session <id> · " + Reason}] (no first_line); Mode "diverged" or "error" → State "waiting", Stop = {Kind "git", Phase, Reason, At now}, Queue.Stop(Reason), actions [{post stop "<phase> not started: git" numbers Reason}]. PhaseDone: State "running" or "paused" and phase == Phase → actions [{Kind "end_check", Phase}] (nothing else changes); otherwise (nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: phase_done %q while %s %q", ErrPhaseMismatch, phase, State, Phase)). EndChecked (State "running" or "paused"; else nil): e.OK → StretchUSD += SessionUSD; out, err := Queue.Done(Phase, next) where next is the id after the current one in Queue.Phases (or "") — err is impossible here and ignored; actions start with [{Kind "kill"}]; then by out: Next and no Stop → the loop begins that phase at once (the Begin transition: Stop nil, Nudged false, Alerted false, SessionUSD 0): Phase = out.Next, State "starting", SessionID "", actions += [{Kind "start_check", Phase: out.Next}] (Queue.Start() called); Stop "smoke" or "operator" → State "waiting", Stop {Kind out.Stop, Phase: the finished phase, Reason "stop after " + out.Stop, At now}, actions += [{post stop "<phase> done: stop after <kind>" numbers "next <out.Next> · waiting for continue"}]; Stop "end" → State "waiting", Stop {Kind "end", Phase, Reason "plan complete", At now}, actions += [{post end "<phase> done: plan complete" numbers "stretch $<StretchUSD 'f' 4>"}]. e not OK → State "waiting", Stop {Kind "not_pushed", Phase, Reason: e.Problems joined with "; ", At now}, Queue.Stop(Reason), no kill, actions [{post stop "<phase> not pushed" numbers Reason}]. WaitOperator: State "running" or "paused" → State "waiting", Stop {Kind: kind, Phase, Reason, IssueURL, At now}, Queue.Stop(kind), actions [{post stop "<phase>: wait_operator <kind>" numbers = reason, then " · " + issueURL when non-empty}]; other states → nil. Continue: State must be "waiting" else (nil, control.ErrNotWaiting); Stop.Kind "not_pushed" → Queue.Continue() then Queue.Start() (the queue runs the same phase again), actions [{end_check Phase}] with State "running" and Stop nil; otherwise Queue.Continue() (its error returned as is) then the Begin transition (Queue.Start, Phase = its id, State "starting", Stop nil, …, actions [{start_check}]); the session id is drawn in StartChecked, so neither Begin nor Continue takes an id source. Restart: State "running" or "paused" → actions [{Kind "kill"}, {Kind "start_check", Phase}], State "starting", SessionID "", Resumes nil; "idle", "starting" or "waiting" → (nil, control.ErrNoSession).

Behaviour: Declares in supervisor/loop.go, exactly: `type Action struct { Kind string; Phase string; SessionID string; Resume bool; BudgetUSD float64; Line string; Milestone control.Milestone }`; `type Loop struct { Project string `json:"project"`; Queue queue.Queue `json:"queue"`; State string `json:"state"`; Phase string `json:"phase"`; SessionID string `json:"session_id"`; PhaseStartedAt time.Time `json:"phase_started_at"`; Resumes []time.Time `json:"resumes"`; Stop *control.Stop `json:"stop,omitempty"`; PausedUntil time.Time `json:"paused_until"`; StretchUSD float64 `json:"stretch_usd"`; SessionUSD float64 `json:"session_usd"`; LastEventAt time.Time `json:"last_event_at"`; Nudged bool `json:"nudged"`; Alerted bool `json:"alerted"` }`; `type Config struct { MaxResumesPerHour int; StallMinutes int; StretchUSD float64; UsageAlertPercent int }`; `var ErrPhaseMismatch = errors.New("phase mismatch")`; `func New(project string, q queue.Queue) *Loop` (State "idle"); `func (l *Loop) Begin(now time.Time) ([]Action, error)`; `func (l *Loop) StartChecked(s gitrules.Start, newID func() string, now time.Time) []Action`; `func (l *Loop) PhaseDone(phase, next string) ([]Action, error)`; `func (l *Loop) EndChecked(e gitrules.End, now time.Time) []Action`; `func (l *Loop) WaitOperator(kind, reason, issueURL string, now time.Time) []Action`; `func (l *Loop) Continue(now time.Time) ([]Action, error)`; `func (l *Loop) Restart(now time.Time) ([]Action, error)`. State is one of "idle", "starting", "running", "paused", "waiting". A post action is Action{Kind: "post", Milestone: {kind, headline, numbers}}. An action carries only the fields its literal names here, every other field zero: start_check and end_check {Kind, Phase}; spawn {Kind, Phase, SessionID, Resume, BudgetUSD}; first_line and write {Kind, Line}; kill {Kind}; post {Kind, Milestone}. Begin (meant for State "idle" or "waiting"): Queue.Start() must succeed — its error is returned as is and nothing changes (a starting, running or paused loop holds a running queue, so a Begin there fails on the queue's state); then Phase = that id, State "starting", Stop nil, Nudged false, Alerted false, SessionUSD 0, actions [{Kind "start_check", Phase}]. StartChecked (State "starting"; any other state → nil): Mode "fresh" → SessionID = newID(), Resumes nil, PhaseStartedAt = now, LastEventAt = now, State "running", actions [{Kind "spawn", Phase, SessionID, Resume false, BudgetUSD = the current phase''s Caps.ClaudeUSD}, {Kind "first_line", Line "/morph-orchestrator " + Phase}, {post start "<phase> started" numbers "session <id> · cap $<ClaudeUSD 'f' -1> · <Hours 'f' -1> h"}] (a Reason "pulled to …" appends " · " + Reason to the numbers); Mode "resume" → SessionID kept when non-empty else newID(), State "running", PhaseStartedAt = now, LastEventAt = now, actions [{spawn Resume true …}, {post start "<phase> resumed" numbers "session <id> · " + Reason}] (no first_line); Mode "diverged" or "error" → State "waiting", Stop = {Kind "git", Phase, Reason, At now}, Queue.Stop(Reason), actions [{post stop "<phase> not started: git" numbers Reason}]. PhaseDone: State "running" or "paused" and phase == Phase → actions [{Kind "end_check", Phase}] (nothing else changes); otherwise (nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: phase_done %q while %s %q", ErrPhaseMismatch, phase, State, Phase)). EndChecked (State "running" or "paused"; else nil): e.OK → StretchUSD += SessionUSD; out, err := Queue.Done(Phase, next) where next is the id after the current one in Queue.Phases (or "") — err is impossible here and ignored; actions start with [{Kind "kill"}]; then by out: Next and no Stop → the loop begins that phase at once (the Begin transition: Stop nil, Nudged false, Alerted false, SessionUSD 0): Phase = out.Next, State "starting", SessionID "", actions += [{Kind "start_check", Phase: out.Next}] (Queue.Start() called); Stop "smoke" or "operator" → State "waiting", Stop {Kind out.Stop, Phase: the finished phase, Reason "stop after " + out.Stop, At now}, actions += [{post stop "<phase> done: stop after <kind>" numbers "next <out.Next> · waiting for continue"}]; Stop "end" → State "waiting", Stop {Kind "end", Phase, Reason "plan complete", At now}, actions += [{post end "<phase> done: plan complete" numbers "stretch $<StretchUSD 'f' 4>"}]. e not OK → State "waiting", Stop {Kind "not_pushed", Phase, Reason: e.Problems joined with "; ", At now}, Queue.Stop(Reason), no kill, actions [{post stop "<phase> not pushed" numbers Reason}]. WaitOperator: State "running" or "paused" → State "waiting", Stop {Kind: kind, Phase, Reason, IssueURL, At now}, Queue.Stop(kind), actions [{post stop "<phase>: wait_operator <kind>" numbers = reason, then " · " + issueURL when non-empty}]; other states → nil. Continue: State must be "waiting" else (nil, control.ErrNotWaiting); Stop.Kind "not_pushed" → Queue.Continue() then Queue.Start() (the queue runs the same phase again), actions [{end_check Phase}] with State "running" and Stop nil; otherwise Queue.Continue() (its error returned as is) then the Begin transition (Queue.Start, Phase = its id, State "starting", Stop nil, …, actions [{start_check}]); the session id is drawn in StartChecked, so neither Begin nor Continue takes an id source. Restart: State "running" or "paused" → actions [{Kind "kill"}, {Kind "start_check", Phase}], State "starting", SessionID "", Resumes nil; "idle", "starting" or "waiting" → (nil, control.ErrNoSession).
